core_question: Does response-conditioned entropy-path invariance identify item-specific training exposure beyond global RL-induced policy rigidity and intrinsic task determinism?
model_scope: One exact model checkpoint, tokenizer, prompt harness and runtime environment per request.

probe_envelope.score: baseline versus task-only unfamiliar-method entropy-path similarity
baseline versus meaning-preserving paraphrase entropy-path similarity
baseline versus equivalent transformed task entropy-path similarity
baseline versus valid alternate-method entropy-path similarity

score_decomposition.global_policy_entropy: baseline_mean_entropy_nats; lower-tail rank against clean controls denotes unexpectedly low entropy for the matched stratum.
score_decomposition.global_task_path_rigidity: mean(prompt_only, semantic_paraphrase, constraint_reparameterization, alternate_valid_method when applicable); higher means the task/policy remains rigid under non-response-conditioned interventions.
score_decomposition.response_conditioned_excess: response_conditioned_self_critique_similarity - global_task_path_rigidity; higher means the response-conditioned intervention preserves the entropy path more than the alternative intervention envelope.

calibration.ties: Conservative; all equal values count as extreme.
calibration.alpha_resolution: For 1% resolution, each matched clean-control group needs at least 99 independent units; this is only p-value resolution, not FPR precision.
calibration.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Yekutieli within each task_family × difficulty_band × path_multiplicity group, conditional on valid super-uniform clean-control ranks.

independence_and_provenance.unit: Independent source/task cluster, not individual generations or repeated prompt variants.
independence_and_provenance.split_overlap: Calibration and evaluation unit IDs and source_cluster_sha256 digests must be globally disjoint.
independence_and_provenance.path_adjudication: At least three reviewers and at least 900/1000 agreement for accepted single/few-path or multiple-valid-path labels; indeterminate labels remain abstentions.
independence_and_provenance.exposure_truth: Known exposure labels come from sealed training manifests and randomized intervention receipts, never from detector scores.

target_metrics: FPR/TPR and exact uncertainty by hard-control cell
coverage, abstention, AUPRC, TPR at fixed 1/5/10% FPR
probe generation count, tokens, logprob width, latency and GPU memory
claim_ceiling: Low baseline entropy is not proof of item-specific contamination.
High task/path rigidity is not proof of training membership.
Response-conditioned excess is a diagnostic contrast, not a causal membership test.
Conformal-style p-values depend on clean-control exchangeability within the exact matched group.
BY controls FDR only if the underlying null p-values are super-uniform.
Model-pair training interventions remain the causal uncertainty units; items and generations are nested.
The report cannot authenticate reviewers, model custody or true training inclusion.
